title: Push notifications broken on Android 15
text:
Hi Wop,

Heads up: push notifications aren't arriving on phones with Android 15. iOS and older Android versions work fine.

What I know so far:
- It affects about a third of our Westbrook beta testers (Tomás confirmed 5 of his 12 testers are on Android 15).
- Students don't get the "Your study group meets in 30 minutes" reminder, which is our most important notification.
- It looks like Android 15 needs a new permission request that our app never asks for.

I opened an issue in the pairly-mobile repo on GitHub with the details and steps to reproduce. I think I can have a fix in 2 to 3 days, so it shouldn't affect the Nov 2 launch, but let's keep it on the risk list for Thursday's sync.

Sam Okafor
Mobile Developer, Pairly
